shared_elements: bird/raptor head with hooked beak in profile
broadly symmetrical framing element above the main figure
justification: Both surfaces feature a hook-beaked bird head in profile and a band of zigzag/chevron ornament running horizontally above the main imagery, plus repeated disc shapes, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge completely: A is a single frontal, bilaterally symmetric winged anthropomorph rendered as flat, brightly coloured outline drawing, while B is a monochrome carved stone pillar with stacked registers of separate animal figures in low relief.
